lesson_card.plain_english: the trail of accountability when an AI-shaped decision helps, harms, approves, denies, or misses something important
lesson_card.big_question: If the AI gets the answer right most of the time, why are we still nervous?
lesson_card.simple_analogy: a relay race where the baton is blame; the model, vendor, institution, and human signer all touch it
lesson_card.common_misunderstanding: People focus on the launch. The useful question is who gains control, who inherits risk, and what changes tomorrow.
lesson_card.listener_payoff: By the end, listeners should understand liability chain well enough to explain why today's AI story matters tomorrow.
lesson_card.operator_lesson: Do not ask only what launched. Ask what new permission, risk, cost, or accountability chain just appeared.
lesson_card.episode_spine: NVIDIA launched OpenShell, a reference architecture for safe enterprise AI agents is not just a breakthrough story; it is a liability-chain story about who owns the mistake.
